ticket.summary: Sewage backing up through bathtub drain with toilet gurgling when kitchen sink runs — main line blockage at 9 Delmore St; on-call plumber paged.
mitigation_advice: Stop using all water immediately — no flushing, sinks, laundry or dishwasher [PB-05]
Keep people and pets away from the affected area and do not touch standing sewage [PB-05]
ticket.customer_message: Thanks — 9 Delmore St, confirmed. Our on-call plumber has been paged and typically arrives within about 60–90 minutes after hours; he'll call you directly from the road. Keep the water off until he's there, and stay clear of the tub area [PB-05]. After-hours emergency dispatch is $150; he'll assess the main line on site and quote any repair before starting.
